lines.en: I head over to the library to see what Futaba is doing and, hold onto the edge of your seat for this, she’s reading.
lines.zh: 我去图书馆看 Futaba 在做什么——各位可坐稳了——她在看书。

lines.en: Her attention immediately switches to me as I’m more interesting than any sort of book she could possibly pick up, and likely packed with significantly more secrets as well.
lines.zh: 她的注意力立刻转到了我身上，因为我比她能拿起的任何一本书都有意思，而且大概还藏着多得多的秘密。

lines.en: Unfortunately for her (And even less fortunately for me), those secrets are pressed so far into the back of my mind that it would take the world’s most seasoned psychological spelunker to uncover them.
lines.zh: 对她来说不巧（对我来说就更不巧了），那些秘密被压在我脑海最深处，得派世界上最老练的心理洞穴探险家才挖得出来。

lines.en: Seeing as Futaba is not at all qualified for that job, the two of us make idle chit chat about things that will not cause my mind to melt into a puddle of Jell-O.
lines.zh: 既然 Futaba 完全胜任不了这份工作，我们就随口聊了些不会让我的脑子化成一滩果冻的话题。

lines.en: I wind up asking her about how her journey as a writer is going, but it seems she hasn’t had much time to write at all as of late.
lines.zh: 到最后我问起她写作这条路走得如何，可她最近似乎根本没多少时间写东西。

lines.en: I can’t tell if that’s the truth or just some sort of excuse she’s coming up with to avoid disappointing me, but it’s not as if I’d be majorly disappointed to begin with.
lines.zh: 我分不清这是实话，还是她为了不让我失望而编的借口；不过我本来也没那么容易失望。

lines.en: The whole reason I pushed her so hard down that path in the beginning was to help give her an outlet to express herself and distract her from the depressing and untrue thoughts that plagued her mind.
lines.zh: 当初我那么使劲推她走上这条路，纯粹是为了给她一个表达自己的出口，好让她从那些困扰着她的、沮丧又不真实的念头里分神。

lines.en: But she has several different avenues to express herself now, and an even larger roster of people willing to listen.
lines.zh: 可她现在有了好几条不同的途径来表达自己，愿意听她说话的人也更多了。

lines.en: She doesn’t need to write anymore.
I leave the library before my mind moves any further away from her.
lines.zh: 趁我的思绪还没离她更远，我离开了图书馆。
Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!
